motivation: S4's C0-only counterfactual model failed: its features are post-treatment, so P(fail|counts) does not transfer across arms. S7 conditions on the arm instead.

design.data: S1 npz: 92 keys x 3000 errors, arms {0,+1,+2,+3,-1}, features (n_false, n_true, w1) per arm
design.fit: keys 8..53 x the four NON-held-out arms
design.prediction: held-out arm's DFR = mean of predicted probabilities over held-out keys, using the held-out arm's own features (no decoding)
design.selection: held-out-C0 log-loss is NOT applicable here (C0 is itself an arm); select by mean held-out log-loss across the four leave-one-out folds, then report the risk ratios for ALL arms as measured -- the selection never sees an arm's RR

grading: same scale as the SURROGATE protocol amendment-1: SUCCESS if the measured RR lies inside the measured CI95 AND the prediction is within a factor of 1.5 in >=3/4 of the folds
